# XHelpers Pro 1.0.11 (23)
- Music & Playlists is now the standalone Tonale app. The Music & Playlists entry in XHelpers Pro opens Tonale. If Tonale is not installed, XHelpers Pro can download it through Xintech's Tonale update feed, verify its update signature and Developer ID signature, and install it for you. - Window Outline (formerly Active Window Highlight): give each window its own outline color with Window Outline Colors, available in the Window Outline settings and by keyboard shortcut. The settings now group border and glow options in one form with a live preview, and accept typed values. - Keep Mac Awake: the menu row shows the active mode at a glance, including a timer's end time and whether the display is also kept awake. The submenu stays open while you change modes. - Pointer, scroll, remapping, Window Outline, and Audio Mixer settings show clearly when the feature is turned off. - Keep the Permissions dialog at a stable size and let descriptions use the full row width. - AI Usage: choose which accounts the hover card lists and in what order, tint each account by provider, color quota bars by what is left, and show reset times more clearly. AI Usage now recovers from refused collections without a restart, keeps Claude credentials readable after the Claude CLI rotates them, offers a working repair when credential access must be allowed, and names the Claude Code version it found and the version it needs when sign-in refuses an older one. - Audio Player: add a three-way pin, a more compact queue, and an optional magnet that docks the player to screen edges and corners. Maximizing no longer pauses playback, long titles no longer resize the player, and the YouTube playback notice can be turned off. - Mixer: show short sounds from players without an app bundle, such as Claude Code's chime, with the launching app's icon. - Review and remove all detected free-edition copies together in one clearer cleanup window. - Fix the Snap & Arrange Windows submenu jumping while open, and two image capture shortcuts that could trigger the wrong action. Window recall diagnostics are now hidden by default. - Translate the new interface text across all 25 supported translation languages.
Xin account features remain disabled in this release. Tonale is a separate app with its own library and settings; it starts fresh and does not import music data from earlier versions of XHelpers Pro.
